name: llama-swap + vLLM coder-32b (.58 RTX 5090)
purpose: the big-model host: llama-swap v240 on :9292 starts vLLM Qwen/Qwen3-32B-AWQ (64k context, fp8 KV, YaRN x2, hermes tools, qwen3 reasoning) as qwen-32b-vllm / coder-32b (coder-32b-nothink through the router) on first request, through a VRAM gate (refuses below 30000 MiB free), and stops it after 300 idle seconds; the router llm.pow (PowStation config/litellm/config.yaml) serves it as coder-32b and falls back to gpu-195's general when it refuses or the box is off. Config, gate script and unit file live in the local-llm-stack checkout (powos/), deployed by its powos/install.sh
image: docker.io/vllm/vllm-openai:latest (the vLLM container llama-swap runs, vllm-qwen32b)
unbounded: no memory/cpu/pid limits yet: llama-swap is a bare systemd --user service and the vLLM container runs without --memory/--cpus (local-llm-stack's script); VRAM is bounded by --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 and the gate
autosleep: llama-swap ttl 300 s (the proxy stays up, no VRAM)

keep: vllm-hf-cache (podman volume, 38 GB: Qwen3-32B-AWQ, and Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct-AWQ, unused since 2026-10-21; podman volume rm vllm-hf-cache to drop both)
~/Projects/local-llm-stack (the checkout; also holds the Ollama compose)
